analysis_scope: retrospective, previously exposed outcomes; not new independent confirmation
primary_system: Proposed Phase12F frozen deployment; no refitting or alteration of model probabilities

cohorts.HAM: development lesion-disjoint OOF, remove true akiec; retained predicted akiec counted incorrect
cohorts.Derm7pt: exact locked 987 eligible cases; six shared true classes; retained seven predicted classes, akiec predictions counted incorrect
cohorts.BCN: exploratory secondary only; not used for main title decision

outcome: correct = int(prediction top1 equals true label); no class collapsing or probability renormalization

glm.lrt: 2*(logLik_full-logLik_reduced), chi-square reference df=5, report as conventional likelihood-ratio test
glm.cluster_method_chosen: cluster-robust sandwich covariance at lesion_id level in HAM; Derm7pt each case gets an independent cluster identifier
glm.joint_robust_test: five-parameter cluster-robust joint Wald chi-square, reported alongside LRT
glm.inference_rule: Main title criterion requires conventional LRT df5 p<0.05, five-parameter cluster-robust joint Wald p<0.05, and sensitivity LRT df3 and sensitivity cluster-robust joint Wald df3 each p<0.05. Conventional LRT is not cluster robust.
glm.separation_fallback: detect perfect/quasi separation or optimizer non-identifiability; use bias-reduced Firth logistic in full and reduced models, document solver and fit before inference; if robust joint inference unavailable, mark primary title decision INDETERMINATE, do not force pass

sensitivity.evaluate: Refit the df/VASC-excluded subset and test the remaining cohort×class interaction using the predeclared LRT df3 and cluster-robust joint Wald df3; report p values and denominators. Coefficient-sign agreement is not a valid sensitivity gate in this saturated GLM.

reference_policy.primary: HAM development OOF predictions for deployed Phase12F
reference_policy.optional_sensitivity: W1 M1 per-class data only if available with verified provenance; not substituted for primary OOF or used to choose model

title_gate.decision_if_failed: Do not retain class-dependent wording based on M7; choose narrower descriptive title language. If any test not estimable, gate INDETERMINATE and no title promotion.

datasets: BCN exploratory if valid matched records exist
per_class_table.undefined_rule: report NA and underlying denominator, never replace undefined precision by zero silently
per_class_table.probability_rule: frozen archive predictions only, no new inference or fitting

bootstrap: NO new fitting; no bootstrap selected (cluster-robust SE chosen for W6)
source_gates: sha256 all frozen source files before case-level access
all image/case identities unique per cohort
HAM lesion_id clustering and no lesion crossing folds
Derm7pt exactly 987 eligible and true akiec absent
all six class mappings locked and seven output dimensions unchanged
per-system per-cohort keywise identity matching verified before differences
new immutable output directory and atomic artifact writes
notes: GLM coefficients are cohort contrasts in correct-class conditional accuracy and not calibration
Sparse DF/VASC strata can cause instability; separation diagnostics mandatory
No inferential claim about BCN interaction; describe only
Firth fallback is conditional and must not be assumed standard chi-square valid under cluster dependence

reporting_effect_scale.inferential_scale: log odds via binomial GLM cohort-by-class interaction
reporting_effect_scale.descriptive_scale: percentage point change in per-class recall (Derm7pt minus HAM) with class support and both cohort recall values
reporting_effect_scale.reference_note: BCC is reference for individual coefficients; these are relative differences versus BCC, NOT absolute worsening or improvement. LRT and joint Wald reference invariant under full-rank coding.
reporting_effect_scale.saturated_model_note: Removing DF/VASC does not change identifiable remaining class-by-cohort cell logits; directional consistency was vacuous.

change_log.timing: before any W6 case-level file load, scoring, or model fit
change_log.change: Replace non-identifying sensitivity_direction_consistent title condition with sensitivity LRT df3 p<0.05 AND sensitivity cluster-robust joint Wald df3 p<0.05
change_log.reason: Saturated cohort×class binomial GLM estimates cohort-class cells independently; deleting DF/VASC cannot meaningfully test coefficient sign stability of remaining interactions.

change_log.timing: before any W6 case-level file load
change_log.change: Mandate per-class absolute recall changes in percentage points and explicitly label BCC-referenced interaction coefficients relative, not absolute.
